text:
Mina (security): Quick async check — running a dependency sweep for SOC2 evidence related to audit-log ingestion + KMS/HSM. Goal: close controls mapped to LOG-2 and CR-4 by end of next sprint. Who's owning the KMS staging key rotation test?

Jonathan (infra): I can take the KMS rotation test. Found one blocker: staging's HSM attestation token expired yesterday, so wrapping calls return 401. I opened INFRA-619 for renewal.

Mina (security): Thanks — can you add the attestation step to the playbook and drop the new step in docs (link to control matrix would help)? Irene, is the current evidence template okay if we include the attestation artifact?

Irene (compliance): Yes, attestation PDF + signed timestamp is acceptable. Please put the S3 path in the evidence table. Also request a csv export of ingest-delivery latency for the last 30 days for LOG-2.

Alex (eng-runtime): Heads-up: when we replayed audit events into the new consumer this morning I saw a schema mismatch for field 'user_agent'. Small PR to fix forward-compat is in flight: https://git.redwood/p/r/4821 — it's safe to merge after QA.

Sam (product): FYI, product wants confirmation that audit events will keep request_id and session_id for tracing (we'll need that for the incident drill). Can you confirm?

Alex (eng-runtime): Yep — request_id/session_id preserved. The mismatch is about optional user_agent nested object vs string; PR #4821 normalizes it. We also added a short test you can run locally:

```bash
# local replay test (dev environment)
curl -X POST https://internal-audit.redwood/v1/ingest \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TEST_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"event":"login","request_id":"req-123","session_id":"sess-456","user_agent":"curl/7.82.0"}'
```

Mina (security): Great. Jonathan, once INFRA-619 is patched, can you run the KMS wrap/unwrap smoke and paste the successful output here? We need the evidence snippet for the binder. Example payload we want verified against the staging key: 

```json
{"key_id":"staging-kms-2026","operation":"wrap","data":"deadbeef"}
```

Jonathan (infra): Will do. If the attestation renewal is blocking CI deploy, deploy-bot just flagged that the canary failed for dedicated-staging earlier (deploy-bot: Canary failed: audit-consumer-1 — 503 upstream). Investigating root cause now.

deploy-bot: Canary roll for audit-consumer v2.3.1 failed on 3/02 09:12 UTC — rollback initiated.

ops-bot: Notified oncall: @jonathan, @alex. Creating incident stub: INC-2026-84 (trace attached).

Mina (security): Ok, immediate plan:
- Jonathan: prioritize attestation renewal + run KMS wrap smoke and drop snippet here by EOD. (INFRA-619)
- Alex: merge PR #4821 and run the local replay test, confirm request_id/session_id retention.
- Irene: update evidence table with S3 paths and expected artifact names.
- Sam: confirm product's drill checklist references request/session ids.

Irene (compliance): I'll update the matrix and leave a comment with the S3 path once the artifact lands.

Jonathan (infra): Quick status — attestation token renewed, HSM responded with OK, KMS wrap/unwrap smoke succeeding:

```
wrap: key=staging-kms-2026 status=OK wrapped_len=64
unwrap: key=staging-kms-2026 status=OK
```

Mina (security): :white_check_mark: perfect — paste the PDF attestation + S3 URI when you have them. Also drop the audit ingestion latency csv to the compliance workspace (Irene).

Alex (eng-runtime): Merged #4821, replay test passed locally. I pushed a small canary fix to avoid the 503 (INFRA change). Will monitor the canary; ops-bot should post results.

ops-bot: Canary redeploy succeeded at 3/02 10:06 UTC — audit-consumer v2.3.1 stable.

Sam (product): Thanks team. If we keep this pace we should have everything for the SOC2 fieldwork snapshot next Thursday.

Mina (security): Nice work. I'll collect the artifacts into the binder and ping the auditor thread when done. If anyone hits follow-up issues, drop them into INFRA-619 or tag me directly. :eyes:
